docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $4,702.00 FILED BY HERMANDAD DE EL SENOR DE LOS MILAGROS-JOSE ROSAS AS TO DEFENDANT CALVO,JULIO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-20-1994 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 03
